## What changed since `fork-2026.11.12-096e225`

This release closes two differences from upstream Zed 1.28.0-pre that the
previous release still had.

**Git Graph**
- The graph columns get their width in the very frame in which the commit
  details panel opens, closes, is dragged or moves. Before, that frame was drawn
  with the old width and the columns jumped one frame later.

**Language servers**
- With servers set to start automatically, a server asked for again after
  everything was stopped serves every language it serves, as upstream does. The
  limit to the languages a server was started for applies only to the by-hand
  setting.
